Instrument.name: Microindenter
Instrument.description: The micro-indentation system (MCT^3, Micro Combi Tester) enables precise measurement of hardness, elastic modulus, and deformation behavior at the micrometer scale. It applies controlled loads while recording force–displacement data to characterize materials such as meteorites, ceramics, glass, and cement paste. The system is equipped with a variety of indenter tips, including Berkovich, Vickers, Flat Punch, Rockwell, and Conical geometries, allowing flexibility for testing materials with different hardness and texture. This versatility makes it ideal for studying heterogeneous and porous materials, complementing our nano-indentation and friability testing capabilities.
